title.en: An Act Conferring Jurisdiction Upon Justices of the Peace in the Moro Province to Try Persons Charged With Infraction of Municipal Ordinances.

text.en:
Justices of the peace in the Moro Province shall have original jurisdiction to try persons charged
with infraction of municipal ordinances arising within the limits of their respective territorial jurisdictions:
Provided, however. That this provision shall not be construed to repeal in any way the provisions of section
twenty-seven of Act Numbered Seven hundred and eighty-seven, as amended.

This Act shall take effect on October first, nineteen hundred and eleven.
Enacted, August 7, 1911.
